### Infographics
- Must use image generation LLM (NOT Python) — Gemini Flash Image or Flux via OpenRouter
- ALL business book infographics MUST be grayscale only (black, white, shades of gray) — no color
- After grayscale conversion, enhance contrast 1.5x for text/linework readability
- Completed for Crisis Ready Co (40 infographics + 8 forms → B&W)

### TOC — MANDATORY
- Every book must have a TOC with synchronized page numbers
- Each entry on ONE LINE, no word wrapping
- CSS: table-layout: auto, white-space: nowrap, dotted leaders
- NO `<a>` tags in TOC cells (plain text only for print PDFs)
- NO `string-set` on h1/h2 (corrupts TOC in weasyprint)

## Memory Tool Pitfall (2026-05-28)
memory(action=replace) with old_text replaces ONLY the matched entry — all other entries stay, but the matched one is overwritten entirely. If old_text matches a section header that had sub-entries, those sub-entries are NOT deleted — they become orphaned duplicates. Always check memory state after replace. To update a specific field, match the exact bullet text, not a section header.

## WeasyPrint TOC Pitfalls (2026-05-28)
- NEVER use `string-set` on h1/h2 -- corrupts all TOC text in weasyprint
- NEVER use `<a>` tags in TOC table cells for print PDFs -- use plain text
- Use `table-layout: auto` (not `fixed`) for TOC tables
- `@top-center { content: none; }` (not `string(chapter-title)`)
- Verify: check for garbled "thing Changed" / "verythin" fragments
